newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa board offers 15,000 T yellow maize.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa board offers 15,000 T yellow maize.

text.p: South Africa's Maize Board said on Monday it would offer by way of a tender 15,000 tonnes of yellow maize for either export or domestic use.
It said the offer would close at noon on January 16.
The successful tenderer would be notified the following day.
The board said in a statement maize for export would be shipped in a 15,000 tonne unit in the period March 29 to April 7.
The minimum price the board would consider for maize which is to be used domestically would be import parity plus 20 rand a tonne, it said.
